primary.exposure_anchor: Round 3/1 interview, 2024 for Panel 28 and Panel 29
primary.comparator: known and classifiable non-current, including past Long COVID
primary.excluded: unresolved current status, unresolved Long COVID history, routing conflicts, invalid age, nonpositive person weight

implemented.no_history_comparator: unadjusted only; cannot infer an adjusted restricted-history association
implemented.interview_insurance_adjustment: implemented; paired to base model on the same insurance-complete sample

diagnostic_only.psu_influence: leave-one PSU weighted mean contrast perturbation; not jackknife SE
diagnostic_only.tail_spending: leave-top-one/top-five per group weighted point contrast; not trimmed primary estimator
diagnostic_only.cross_covariate_overlap: joint age band by sex/region/panel support counts; not formal positivity proof

deferred: full two-part refit after high-spending exclusions
formal causal identification or overlap weighting
out_of_scope: Long COVID attributable or avoidable costs

uncertainty.adjusted: full-person-design bootstrap with both models refit each replicate
uncertainty.interval: t based, df from full PERSON design
uncertainty.failure_policy: fail-closed, identify full-sample or replicate column, stage, group, support; no replicate deletion
uncertainty.covariance: finite symmetric PSD within tolerance; negative marginal variances rejected

precision_screen.interpretation: Preliminary numeric advisory only; public display and publication require independent signoff
